data.name: Description
data.value: The servers and models Jarvis talks to. The default model answers; it must be local at this stage. Claude and ChatGPT can be set up and tested now; they answer later, through the hand-off.

data.name: CloudNote
data.value: Cloud provider: it can be set up and tested, but it does not answer yet.

data.name: Think
data.value: Let the model reason before answering (slower)

data.name: KeepLoaded
data.value: Load the model at start and keep it in memory

data.name: AdvancedHint
data.value: Defaults: reasoning off, context 4096, temperature 0.3. On a 12 GB card, keep the context at 8192 or less.

data.name: KeyOptional
data.value: API key (only if the server asks for one)

data.name: Passed
data.value: Connection passed in {0} ms. Model “{1}” is available.

data.name: Failure_NotConfigured
data.value: No default provider: add one, then make it the default.

data.name: Failure_InvalidAddress
data.value: The address is not valid: it starts with http:// or https://, for instance http://127.0.0.1:11434.

data.name: Failure_Unreachable
data.value: Server unreachable: check the address and the port, and that the server is started.

data.name: Failure_ModelMissing
data.value: The server does not have the model “{0}”: download it (ollama pull {0}) or pick one the server lists.

data.name: Failure_KeyMissing
data.value: No API key: save it in the field above.

data.name: Failure_KeyRejected
data.value: Key refused by the server: check it, or create a new one.

data.name: Failure_TimedOut
data.value: Timed out: the server did not answer within {0} s.

data.name: Failure_ServerError
data.value: The server answered with an error. The detail is in the log.

data.name: NoDefault
data.value: No default model: Jarvis cannot answer until a local provider is the default.

data.name: Saved
data.value: Saved. The default model applies at once.

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: The settings could not be saved: the settings file cannot be written. See the log for the cause.
